title: A low-cost liquid crystal display (LCD)-printed microfluidic device: fabrication and application in the biodegradation of petroleum hydrocarbons in petroleum refinery sludge
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23044-23057
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06174A, Paper

Amlan Ashish, Ankita Debnath, Poulomi Biswas, Ramkrishna Sen, Gorachand Dutta
Liquid crystal display (LCD) printing is revolutionizing the biological domain, demonstrating the benefits of fabricating low-cost, high-resolution, complex geometry compared to the time-consuming and labour-intensive lithography techniques.
